label: Step 2 · What to sync
description: Both are on by default. Turning one off stops it from then on; nothing already in Zoho is changed or removed.

fields.label: Products, variants and stock: each linked to a Zoho item, with Zoho owning stock
fields.description: Create or link a Zoho item for every product and variant, and send name, SKU and price changes to Zoho.

fields.label: Orders, customers and payments: sales orders, invoices and payments in Zoho
fields.description: Placed orders become Zoho sales orders (Inventory); paid orders get an invoice and a recorded payment. Customers are added as Zoho contacts with their first order.
